name: ComputerUse
summary: Operate Mac apps in the background
description:
Lets KeepTalking read and operate the apps on this Mac through their accessibility tree and window screenshots, powered by Cua Driver (open source, MIT). Clicks and typing go straight to the target app, so your own cursor and focus stay where they are; a separate agent cursor shows what it is doing.

Each action instance names the apps it may use and whether it may act or only look. KeepTalking itself, password managers and Keychain Access are never reachable; terminals and System Settings only when an instance lists them.

Needs Accessibility and Screen Recording for KT Companion.

permissions.reason: To read the windows of the apps you allow, and click and type in them
To see screenshots of those windows

kinds.name: computer-use
kinds.description: Operate macOS apps in the background through Cua Driver — the user keeps their own cursor and focus. Workflow: list_apps (or launch_app) → list_windows → get_window_state(pid, window_id) returns tree rows with element tokens plus a screenshot → act by element_token (click, type_text, set_value, press_key, hotkey, scroll, invoke_menu) → get_window_state again to check the result; tokens go stale after each snapshot. Use x,y (window screenshot pixels) only for surfaces missing from the tree. Windows on another Space can't be read. Apps outside this instance's scope are refused.

tool.description: Which operation: list_apps — Running and installed apps this instance may use, with pids and windows; list_windows — Windows (id, title, on-screen / other Space) of one app or all permitted apps; get_window_state — A window's accessibility tree (rows with element_token) plus a screenshot; zoom — A close-up JPEG of a window region; follow with from_zoom=true on click; launch_app — Launch (or find) an app in the background and return its pid and windows; click — Click an element (element_token) or window pixels (x,y); type_text — Insert text into the focused field, or the field at element_token / x,y; press_key — Press one key, optionally with modifiers; hotkey — Press a key combination such as cmd+s; set_value — Choose a popup/select option or set a control's value directly; scroll — Scroll at an element or point, or the focused region; invoke_menu — Invoke an app menu item by its label path; drag — Drag between two window points (always briefly takes the foreground); bring_to_front — Activate an app and leave it frontmost (steals focus; rarely needed)

action.description: AX action for element clicks: press (default), show_menu, pick, confirm, cancel, open

amount.description: Wheel notches or key repeats (default 3, max 50)

bundle_id.description: App bundle ID, e.g. com.apple.TextEdit (preferred over name)

capture_id.description: Bind x,y to this exact capture from get_window_state

count.description: Click count for pixel clicks (2 = double-click)

delivery_mode.description: background (default) never fronts the app; foreground briefly fronts the window, acts, then restores the user's app — needs window_id and an instance that allows foreground

element_token.description: Element handle from the latest get_window_state of that window (e.g. s1a2b3c4d:12). Preferred over x,y; stale after the next snapshot

from_zoom.description: x,y are in the last zoom image, not the full window

include_screenshot.description: Attach the window screenshot (default true; false is cheaper when only re-indexing)

key.description: Key name: return, tab, escape, space, delete, up/down/left/right, home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1-f12, or a letter/digit

modifiers.description: Held modifiers: cmd, shift, option, ctrl, fn

name.description: App display name, used when bundle_id is absent

on_screen_only.description: Only windows on the current Space

path.description: Menu labels from the menu bar down, e.g. ["File", "Export as PDF…"]

pid.description: Target app's process ID (from list_apps or launch_app)

query.description: Only return tree rows matching this text (plus their ancestors)

text.description: Text to insert at the target's cursor

urls.description: Files or URLs the launched app should open

value.description: New value: a popup/select option's title, or an AXValue for sliders, steppers, date pickers and plain text fields

x.description: X in the window screenshot's pixels (top-left origin)

y.description: Y in the window screenshot's pixels

allowedApps.title: Apps
allowedApps.description: Bundle IDs or app names this instance may use; empty allows any app except protected ones

control.title: Allow control
control.description: Allow clicking, typing and launching; off = look only

foreground.title: Allow foreground
foreground.description: Allow briefly taking the foreground (drags, menu shortcuts that ignore background input)
